name: release notes: a first install records no release as seen
find: const seen = firstTime ? releases.map(({ id }) => id) : (installedReleases(destination, unit) ?? []);
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/add-to-project.test.mts -t "prints no notes at first install"

name: release notes: the releases are never recorded
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/add-to-project.test.mts -t "notes of a release the project has not seen, once"

name: release notes: a release already seen is printed again
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/add-to-project.test.mts -t "notes of a release the project has not seen, once"

name: release notes: an old record with no list is owed nothing
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/add-to-project.test.mts -t "before release notes"

name: release notes: an install drops the seen list of the record
release notes: the notes are not printed
